# Qualitative inspection of semantic association in specific sentences

```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

setwd("experiment2")
```

## load data
```{r}
tanner_df <- read.csv(file.path("results", "tanner_semantic_association.csv")) |>
    filter(Acceptability == "Gram") |>
    mutate(full_implementation = paste(implementation, model, sep = "_"))

derco_df <- read.csv(file.path("results", "derco_semantic_association.csv")) |>
    mutate(full_implementation = paste(implementation, model, sep = "_")) |>
    group_by(article_n, full_implementation) |>
    mutate(
        sentence_n = cumsum(
            lag(str_detect(target, "\\.$"), default = FALSE)
        )
    ) |>
    ungroup()
```

## visualization: Tanner
Choose sentence
```{r}
sentence_ids <- tanner_df |>
    pull(id) |>
    unique()
sentence_id <- sentence_ids[2]

df <- tanner_df |>
    filter(id == sentence_id) |>
    group_by(implementation, model) |>
    mutate(s_sem = scale(semantic_association)) |>
    ungroup()
```

Print sentences
```{r}
df |>
    pull(word) |>
    unique() |>
    paste(collapse = " ")
```

```{r}
words_df <- df |>
    group_by(word_n) |>
    summarize("word" = unique(word))
```

Heatmap
```{r}
save_fig <- TRUE

p <- df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = word_n, y = full_implementation, fill = s_sem)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "blue3", high = "red2", mid = "thistle1",
        na.value = "grey95",
        midpoint = 0, , limit = c(-5, 5)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = words_df$word_n,
        labels = words_df$word,
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "",
        y = ""
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )

if (save_fig) {
    ggsave(
        file.path(
            "figs",
            paste0("tanner_example_sentence", sentence_id, ".png")
        ),
        height = 4, width = 10
    )
} else {
    p + theme(aspect.ratio = .5)
}
```

## visualization: DERCo
Choose sentence
```{r}
article_id <- 4
sentence_id <- 11

df <- derco_df |>
    filter(article_n == article_id) |>
    filter(sentence_n == sentence_id) |>
    group_by(full_implementation) |>
    mutate(s_sem = scale(semantic_association)) |>
    ungroup()
```

Print sentences
```{r}
df |>
    pull(target) |>
    unique() |>
    paste(collapse = " ")
```

Heatmap
```{r}
save_fig <- TRUE

words_df <- df |>
    group_by(word_n) |>
    summarize("word" = unique(target))

p <- df |>
    filter(!str_detect(implementation, "sentences1")) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = word_n, y = full_implementation, fill = s_sem)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "blue3", high = "red2", mid = "thistle1",
        na.value = "grey95",
        midpoint = 0, , limit = c(-5, 5)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = words_df$word_n,
        labels = words_df$word,
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "",
        y = ""
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )

if (save_fig) {
    ggsave(
        file.path(
            "figs",
            paste0("derco_example_sentence", sentence_id, "_article", article_id, ".png")
        ),
        height = 4, width = 10
    )
} else {
    p + theme(aspect.ratio = .5)
}
```
